reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis incorrectly assumes that annealing Q235 steel at 750 °C will reduce grain boundary defects and residual stresses, when in fact this temperature is in the austenitization range and will cause grain growth and phase transformation, likely increasing defect density and not producing the claimed microstructural refinement.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is well-structured with clear controls, measurements, and a falsification criterion, but it is testing a physically flawed premise, so the test itself is feasible but would not properly evaluate the intended mechanism.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it is based on a fundamental misunderstanding of steel metallurgy; a researcher would be misled by the proposed mechanism and would waste resources on an invalid experiment.
